fallback_text: Database for Trailhead (4 options compared): Postgres with Litestream, medium confidence. Cheapest to run and simplest to restore for one app server. Monthly cost: $0 extra (runs on the current DigitalOcean droplet). Restore time: under 1 minute (restore drill on staging: 41 s). Multi-region writes: no. Would change if you needed writes from two regions, or more than one app server.
